# Skill

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Skill`](gmeow-Skill.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Skill>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/expertise`](../../slices/expertise.md)

A competency or ability an agent possesses — a knowledge, ability, or expertise that can be applied to perform a task. Occupation-independent; aligned to [esco:Skill](http://data.europa.eu/esco/model#Skill) by reference.
